# ClassMinds

> ClassMinds is an iOS app for college students that combines class management, real-time classmate chat, and an AI tutor grounded in your own class notes. One plan at $8.99/month, free during public beta.

## Quick facts
- **Product:** ClassMinds — AI-powered study app
- **Platform:** iOS 17+ (iPhone)
- **Category:** EducationApplication
- **Pricing:** Free during beta; $8.99/month after launch (one plan, every feature)
- **Founder:** Riley Edds (solo developer, college student)
- **Launched:** Public beta, April 2026
- **Tech stack:** SwiftUI, Firebase, OpenAI (GPT-4), Deepgram, OneSignal

## Core features
- **AI Tutor** — answers grounded in your own uploaded class notes, slides, and PDFs (not the open internet)
- **Class Chat** — per-course real-time group chat, scoped to enrolled classmates
- **Class Hub** — assignments, deadlines, notes organized per class
- **Schedule Import** — snap a photo of your schedule; AI parses into courses
- **Audio Transcription** — record lectures, get Deepgram-transcribed notes
- **Smart Notifications** — deadline reminders, mentions, per-type preferences

## Data handling
- Zero-training policy: user notes are never used to train AI models
- OpenAI API in zero-retention mode; Deepgram under same commitment
- Encryption at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3)
- Per-user Firestore access scoping; no cross-user reads
- Full cascade account deletion with tombstoned group-chat messages
